row:
We are a stray Animal Rescue organisation based in Raipur CG. We run our Shelter with the name Vatika Animal Sanctuary. We help animals by giving them treatment and care. We have rescued 10K+ animals till now and currently nour shelter takes care of 250+ paralysed, blind, sick animals. 
Make a Donation for the animals please 😊👇
